defects.defect: Each pack description wraps to two lines, despite the specified one-line description layout.
defects.direction: Widen the description column or reduce its type size so each description fits on one line.

defects.defect: Badge is an opaque flat gold pill sitting over/above the frame rail, overlapping the frame's top border and crowding the $6.99 plate directly below it
defects.direction: Give the badge the same painted ribbon/banner treatment with transparent compositing, and place it clear of the frame rail with breathing room above the price plate
defects.region: 'Best value' badge, pack 3 frame top-right (~x520-660, y795-830)

defects.defect: Flat brown fill behind the top bar, title and blurb reads as dead space and clashes with the painted rift art lower on the page

defects.region: Header/top area behind the currency bar and title (y0-380)

defects.defect: Pack names wrap onto two lines, so the count and 'Gems' stack and compete with the adjacent description column

defects.defect: Restore frame is inset narrower than the pack frames and its Restore button crowds the right rail

defects.defect: Painted rift scene shows no glow or activity, reading as a static empty stage rather than the 'glowing rift' called for

defects.region: Rift scene between Restore row and nav (y1110-1350)
